# PictoCard

> PictoCard is a free, open-source web service for creating and sending custom picture greeting cards by email, as a Discord DM, or as a letter to a Nintendo Wii Message Board (via WiiConnect24 / WiiLink).

## What it does
- Upload any photo or choose a preset, write a message (up to 500 characters), pick a font and text color.
- Optionally add a Mii to the card.
- Deliver by email, by Discord DM (Discord login, no verification code), or to a Wii by its 16-digit Wii Number.
- Wii letters support a Mii face, a picture or PictoCard attachment, and Wii letterheads.
- Recipients can opt out and back in for email, Wii and Discord at any time.

## Pages
- [Send a PictoCard](https://pictocard.net/): the card creator and FAQ
- [Add PictoCard to your Wii](https://pictocard.net/wii): one-time friend request so a Wii can receive PictoCards
- [PictoCard app](https://pictocard.net/wii-app): free homebrew app for Wii, Wii U and 3DS to send cards by email or to a Wii Message Board
- [Opt out or opt in](https://pictocard.net/optout): email, Wii and Discord preferences
- [Privacy](https://pictocard.net/privacy) and [Terms](https://pictocard.net/tos)

## Source
- https://github.com/larsenv/pictocard
- https://github.com/larsenv/PictoCard-Client (Wii, Wii U and 3DS apps)
